attempts.why: Dropdown summary selectors used descendant combinators, so nested accordion summaries inherited the bordered dropdown-button styling; restricting them to the direct child summary fixes the leakage while preserving the outer dropdown button.

selfVerify.reason: Outer dropdown summary retains bordered button styling, while nested 'Solid (accordion)' summary inside the menu is plain with only a chevron and no inherited bordered dropdown-button styling.

pick.suspected: The dropdown's summary button styling applies to descendant summaries instead of only its direct child, so the nested accordion summary inside the dropdown menu is incorrectly rendered as a bordered dropdown button.
